end.summary: Practised sorting small numbers as odd or even by making pairs.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the pairing method with Jiya: numbers are odd when one is left without a partner, and even when everyone has a partner. Jiya gave several correct examples using 7 and 8, but the method was not steady yet and teach-back was not completed. At home, use small groups of buttons or coins to make pairs and ask whether anyone is left over.
